backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, mileage tracking, and permission-gated CRUD operations for fill-ups.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report structure with no listed features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend source files.
frontend/ANDROID.md: Guide for building and deploying the Android TWA app and configuring Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for Android-specific build, IDE, and keystore files.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Gradle config for the Android app defining SDK versions, build types, and dependencies.
frontend/android/app/src/main/AndroidMan: Android manifest configuring TWA launcher activity, deep links, splash screen, and provider settings.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawab: Drawable defining splash screen layout with background color and centered image.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap: Adaptive launcher icon referencing foreground and background drawables.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: Color resources defining primary theme colors and splash background.
String resources for app name, host, and default URL.
App theme definitions including splash screen style and color settings.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/fi: File provider configuration granting cache-path access.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/ne: Network security config restricting cleartext traffic and trusting specific domains.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/sh: Placeholder XML for optional app shortcuts.
frontend/android/bubblewrap.json: Bubblewrap config specifying TWA metadata, host, icons, and build parameters.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Top-level Gradle build config specifying repositories and Android Gradle plugin version.
frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-w: Gradle wrapper configuration pointing to Gradle 8.0 distribution.
frontend/android/README.md: Documentation for configuring, building, and distributing the Android TWA wrapper for the web app.
frontend/android/settings.gradle: Gradle settings file defining project name and modules.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes, applying global border and background/foreground styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the React app, sets metadata, and registers a service worker.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Android App Links configuration delegating URL handling to the TWA package.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, colors, and standalone display settings.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styling and a retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker that caches core assets, cleans old caches, and serves offline or cached responses for GET requests.
frontend/PWA.md: Guide for testing PWA installability and service worker functionality.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication flow, profile setup, and rendering the dashboard within the app shell.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button that integrates with Internet Identity and clears cached data on logout.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Dashboard page showing mileage stats, fill‑up form, filters, and list of fill‑ups with sorting and date filtering.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/FillUp: Displays a list of processed fill‑ups with formatted units, loading skeletons, and an empty state when no data exists.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Filter: UI controls for selecting date ranges and sort order for the fill‑up list using select and toggle components.
frontend/src/components/fillups/FillUpFo: Form dialog for adding fill‑up entries with validation, unit conversion, and actor-based submission handling.
frontend/src/components/fillups/MileageS: Displays computed mileage stats including average, best/worst efficiency, and total distance using fill‑up data.
frontend/src/components/help/HelpContent: Static help content explaining mileage calculations, tips, and definitions of displayed stats.
Dialog wrapper that displays the HelpContent component when opened.
Main layout wrapper with header, footer, user greeting, and action buttons surrounding page content.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Landing and onboarding screen showcasing app features with hero image, descriptions, and login/install actions.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Dialog for creating a user profile with name and unit system selection, saving via profile API.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallAppBu: Button that triggers PWA installation when the app is installable.
frontend/src/features/dashboard/filterin: Provides functions to filter and sort fill‑up entries by date range and order.
frontend/src/features/fillups/types.ts: Defines types for unit systems and fill‑up entry structures used throughout the app.
frontend/src/features/fillups/useFillUps: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and add fill-up entries, converting backend data and computing distance and efficiency.
frontend/src/features/fillups/validation: Validates odometer and fuel inputs, ensuring numeric, positive, and increasing values for fill-up entries.
frontend/src/features/profile/useUserPro: Implements hooks to load, save, and fetch user profile and role via the actor using React Query.
Handles PWA installability state and exposes a method to trigger the browser install prompt.
frontend/src/features/units/units.ts: Defines unit labels and formatting utilities for distance, fuel, and efficiency across metric and imperial systems.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and logic for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file documenting that queries are defined in feature-specific hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/actorError.ts: Normalizes actor call errors into user-friendly messages and structured debugging details.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL params including hash routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, container settings, animations, and plugins such as typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, required image assets, and pending feature requests for adding PWA and Android TWA icons and splash images.
